title: CTX TOTALS — six-county containment, two derivations

snapshot.factory_store: FACTORY_DATABASE_URL via Secret Manager (bytes only; value not recorded)

countingRule.run_derivation: For the persist success run that landing currently holds: sum run_events kind=chunk body.unincorporated / in_city / unresolved / rows. method_version is body.method_version, or implicitMethodVersion(null)=intersection-v1 when the field is absent. Manifest denominator (kind=chunk-manifest) is internal consistency with the same run, not a second derivation.
countingRule.store_derivation: COUNT(*) FROM landing_parcel_jurisdiction GROUP BY county_fips, run_id, disposition. Disposition values are unincorporated and in-city (hyphen). unresolved is the count of any other disposition; observed 0. store_total is the sum of those counts for that run_id.
countingRule.refuse: store_total !== run.chunk_sum.rows. Fired: false on all six.
not_a_derivation: planner docs, including this card's Williamson/Travis table
landing.method (value is ring on every persist row, including covers-v1)

six_county_sum.note: Arithmetic of the six rows. Not a licensed regional figure. Landing disposition totals for these six run_ids equal this sum. Store-wide disposition totals at read time were also 611116 in-city and 370289 unincorporated, so no extra-county landing rows were present.

match_control.what_it_compares: assertInteractiveMatch(county, totals) looks up INTERACTIVE_PARTITIONS. Only 48021 and 48055 have an expected {unincorporated, in_city, total}. On mismatch it refuses PARTITION_MISMATCH. On no expected it returns {checked:false, totals} and does not refuse.
match_control.when_it_runs: apply && !plannedOnly && !onlyRange (full persist, not a measure range).
match_control.covers_v1_checked_false: starved, not dead. The control has no expected triple for 48453 or 48491. Same starve on 48209 and 48309.
match_control.should_it_gate: It already gates 48021 and 48055. It should not gate covers-v1 counties until someone adds expected partitions from a second derivation. Do not treat checked:false as a pass.
